C0167.title: Where Winds Meet Cheat Case Cracked: One Arrested for Illegal Profit of Tens of Thousands of Yuan
C0167.summary: In November 2025, NetEase Legal, in collaboration with public security authorities, arrested cheat developer Qin in Hunan Province. Qin had created a cheat program for the game 'Where Winds Meet' in January 2025 and sold it through QQ groups.
